title: Scalar tensor comparison preserves opposite-shift cancellation
statement: Let X be a scheme and φ:A→B a homomorphism of commutative rings. Let F be derived scalar extension, σ its canonical adjoint-mate shift, and μ its unique flat-model-normalized binary tensor comparison, as in [lem-coef-etale-tensor-model-comparison]. For derived A-module sheaves K,L and n∈ℤ, write c_A(K,L,n):K[-n]⊗L[n]→K⊗L for the tensor-shift cancellation defined there, and similarly c_B. Then (σ_{K,-n}⊗σ_{L,n});c_B(FK,FL,n);μ(K,L) = μ(K[-n],L[n]);F(c_A(K,L,n)). No internal Hom or evaluation map enters this identity.

source.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 08JC; K-flat tensor models and signed shifts

proof.text: Represent K and L by flat-term K-flat complexes. Their shifts are again flat-term K-flat. The defining model normalization of μ identifies the binary comparison with ordinary scalar balancing. The counit characterization of the adjoint-mate scalar shift identifies σ with termwise extension and reindexing. DerivedCategory.commShiftTensorLeft_eq and DerivedCategory.commShiftTensorRight_eq identify the tensor shifts with cochain reindexing on these models.

On each summand of the total tensor complex, both routes first extend scalars and then cancel the shifts -n,n. The two tensor-shift signs occur in the same order; ordinary scalar balancing has degree zero. Hence the maps coincide. Localize using the counit normalization and transport along the representative isomorphisms using naturality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4, 08JC; the tensor-balancing part of the evaluation-transpose shift square

mathlib_searches.query: The canonical derived scalar tensor comparison commutes with cancellation of shifts by n and minus n
mathlib_searches.results: Generic shift and cochain comparison APIs; none identifies the normalized scalar tensor comparison with opposite-shift cancellation.

from.place: Proof paragraph 2, exactness in the first argument: scalar balancing and the signed tensor reindexing used before transposition

lean.statement:
theorem etaleHomTensorComparison_shiftCancellation
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (K L : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).map
        (((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso (-n)).hom.app K)).app
          ((scalarExtension φ X).obj (L⟦n⟧)) ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).obj
        (((scalarExtension φ X).obj K)⟦-n⟧)).map
          (((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso n).hom.app L) ≫
      etaleHomTensorShiftCancellation (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj K) ((scalarExtension φ X).obj L) n ≫
      (etaleHomTensorComparison X φ K L).hom =
    (etaleHomTensorComparison X φ (K⟦-n⟧) (L⟦n⟧)).hom ≫
      (scalarExtension φ X).map
        (etaleHomTensorShiftCancellation (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X K L n)
